desc: Edit c-game/data/pak_1/materials/splat_terrain_ps.hlsl: (a) declare the six Texture2D band samplers (g_SnowAlbedo/g_SnowNormal/g_SandAlbedo/g_SandNormal/g_CliffAlbedo/g_CliffNormal); (b) add the five #ifndef-guarded threshold #defines (SPLAT_SAND_LO/HI, SPLAT_CLIFF_LO/HI, SPLAT_SNOW_LO/HI; fixed-metre defaults per brainstorm A); (c) after the splat chain + base-detail blend, compute worldY = In.AnchoredPos.y + g_Anchor.y and slope = 1 - max(In.WorldNormal.y, 0) on the unperturbed normal, then the sand (low altitude masked near sea level), cliff (smoothstep over slope), snow (high altitude) weights, blended in order sand, cliff, snow into albedo and the tangent-space normal via the existing tiledUV/du/dv SampleGrad on all six — all blends written as c + (t - c)*w (no mix()), band normals blended before the TBN transform. Extend createSplatHlsl (SplatTerrainDiligent.cpp ~L1000-1027) to prepend these five #defines when ENGINE_SPLAT_* env vars are set, with a utils::info line, mirroring the ENGINE_SPLAT_DETAIL_METERS block. result: Six band Texture2Ds + five #ifndef-guarded threshold defaults added to the PS; weights (sand low-altitude beach mask, cliff slope 0.1-0.4, snow 30-60 m) blend albedo + tangent nT before TBN via SampleGrad(tiledUV,du,dv), all c+(t-c)*w; createSplatHlsl now prepends ENGINE_SPLAT_{SAND,CLIFF,SNOW}_{LO,HI} #defines with utils::info logging; compiles at runtime with no splatTerrain warnings; cliff + snow paths visually confirmed in frame-300 screenshot (defaults 30/60 too low for this ~1202 m world — tuning is task 4's job).
